name: Niiyama Moe
source:
She is not married. She is the granddaughter of an annoying grandmother who lives in the apartment building.

She dropped out of high school and was sent to live with her grandmother by her parents who wanted to punish her. She is a natural and boisterous girl who sympathizes with Yuusuke, who is also a dropout.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532765]Getchu[/url]]
